messages:
Rae (PM): Quick thread to lock down the pinning + deprecation spec; want defaults so Sales can quote without engineering back-and-forth.

Lin (Eng): Agreed. Propose catalog 'compat_fingerprint' that includes: arch, tokenizer-v, vocab-hash, quant-level, max-seq. Auto-swap only when fingerprint matches.

Ava (Solutions): Field request: add a tenant dry-run: deploy new variant for a tenant in isolated mode, run retrieval/embed diffs, produce signed migration report.

Sam (Sales): Sales asks: three SKUs for pins (30d free, 90d paid, 180d contractual). Need templated language for renewal flow and list prices.

Nate (Legal): We'll draft a short addendum for paid pins. Need rollback terms and liability cap for regressions after a swap.

Rae (PM): Roadmap items: 1) compatibility fingerprint (eng) 2) pin billing + UI (product/sales) 3) preflight tests & auto-checks (eng-ml) 4) dry-run reports + templates (solutions) 5) legal addendum (legal).

Lin (Eng): I'll post a sample JSON for the fingerprint and a minimal preflight checklist (50-sample prompt bench + embedding-similarity check) by EOD.

Ava (Solutions): I'll prototype the dry-run report and comm templates.

Sam (Sales): Will compile customers asking >90d and estimate ARR impact.

Nate (Legal): Drafting addendum, will share with contracts team.

Rae (PM): Thanks — we'll groom this into Q2.
